info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation Microform Integration API

items.docs: This API is used to generate the Capture Context data structure for the Microform Integration.  Microform is a browser-based acceptance solution that allows a seller to capture payment information is a secure manner from their website.  For more information about Flex Microform transactions, see the [Flex Developer Guides Page](https://developer.cybersource.com/api/developer-guides/dita-flex/SAFlexibleToken.html).
